article.story: SAN ANTONIO -- — Mike Price had 21 points in Chicago State’s 66-54 win against Incarnate Word on Thursday. Price shot 6 of 19 from the field, including 2 for 8 from 3-point range, and went 7 for 9 from the line for the Cougars (1-1). Foday Sheriff scored 11 points while going 5 of 7 from the field. Ben Kalonji finished 3 of 4 from the floor to finish with seven points. Godswill Erheriene led the Cardinals (0-2) in scoring, finishing with 18 points, 10 rebounds and four blocks. Ismail Habib added 14 points for Incarnate Word. D’Arrae Goodwin finished with six points, seven rebounds and four steals. Up next Chicago State plays Monday against South Carolina State at home, and Incarnate Word visits UTEP on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
